text: In 1905, Thomas Richardson, a missionary who lost his faith in Peking, poses as a convert to reach a remote Welsh island where a cult holds his sister Jennifer [for ransom|wrong|exploitation for profit]. Its three founders swear that blood sacrifice made the barren soil fertile. In a barn, the island's goddess lies [bound in tree roots and fed on blood|rules|it must feed], a masked butcher called the Grinder [feeds her the dead|images|corpses and body parts], and a forbidden pregnancy sets [the founders against each other|threat|the group turns on you].
